hypotheses.title: Ethotoin Extends Lifespan Through DAF-2 Insulin-Like Signaling
hypotheses.claim: Ethotoin extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans by inhibiting insulin-like signaling through DAF-2. The longevity effect depends on the presence and activity of the DAF-2 receptor.
hypotheses.rationale: Reduced insulin-like signaling is a conserved pathway that promotes longevity, and pharmacological inhibition of DAF-2 could reproduce the lifespan extension seen in reduced signaling states.
hypotheses.prediction: Ethotoin-treated worms will live significantly longer than untreated controls, and the extension will be abolished in daf-2 loss-of-function or pathway-activated backgrounds.
hypotheses.experiment: Treat synchronized wild-type and daf-2 mutant populations with ethotoin across a dose range, measure survival, and compare with vehicle controls under identical conditions.

hypotheses.title: Baicalein Shortens Lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans
hypotheses.claim: Baicalein shortens lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans. Worms exposed to baicalein will show reduced survival relative to untreated controls.
hypotheses.rationale: Compounds can impose metabolic or toxic stress that overwhelms cellular maintenance systems, and such burden can accelerate aging and reduce survival in short-lived model organisms.
hypotheses.prediction: Baicalein-treated populations will exhibit significantly shorter median and maximum lifespan than vehicle-treated controls.
hypotheses.experiment: Expose synchronized worm cohorts to a dose range of baicalein versus vehicle, score survival longitudinally, and analyze lifespan curves statistically.

hypotheses.title: Baicalein Extends Lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans
hypotheses.claim: Baicalein extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans. Worms exposed to baicalein will show increased survival relative to untreated controls.
hypotheses.rationale: Flavonoids can activate endogenous stress-response and antioxidant pathways, and mild activation of such defenses is a recognized route to slower aging and longer life.
hypotheses.prediction: Baicalein-treated populations will exhibit significantly longer median and maximum lifespan than vehicle-treated controls.
hypotheses.experiment: Expose synchronized worm cohorts to a dose range of baicalein versus vehicle, score survival longitudinally, and analyze lifespan curves statistically.

hypotheses.experiment: Treat synchronized worm cohorts with a graded baicalein dose series including high concentrations, score survival longitudinally, and compare lifespan across doses and vehicle.
